findings.issue: The NodeAgent reconciliation messages display static 'v1 -> v1' badges instead of the progressive state transitions ('v41 -> v42' and 'v42 -> v43'), breaking the provenance chain.
findings.fix: Update the version badges in the chat messages to display the correct progressive state transitions.

findings.issue: Missing the inline cost warning badge ('$0.14 ▲') next to the row title, which hides the cost spike from the high-level trace view.
findings.fix: Add the '$0.14 ▲' warning badge next to the 'synthesis.answer' label in the trace tree.

findings.issue: The confidence transition text is overly verbose ('0.82 - draft - Revenue + COGS variance -> committed') and conflicts with the global 'Draft' status bar state.
findings.fix: Simplify the confidence metadata text to '0.82 -> draft' to align with the reference.

findings.issue: Excessively heavy font weight (bold) on sidebar items makes the navigation chrome too prominent, failing to let it recede.
findings.fix: Reduce the font weight of sidebar items to regular/medium to match the Reference.

findings.issue: Node labels (e.g., 'context.gather', 'fetch.cardionova.com') are rendered in a heavy bold font, disrupting the sober hierarchy of the trace view.
findings.fix: Change the font weight of trace node labels to regular/medium as seen in the Reference.

findings.issue: Chat message text is too bold, which reduces the hierarchical distinction between sender names and message content.
findings.fix: Set the chat message body text to a lighter, regular weight to match the Reference.

findings.issue: Excessive vertical padding on the nested detail rows (tokens.in, tokens.out, cost, confidence) breaks the visual grouping with their parent node, making the trace list feel loose.
findings.fix: Reduce vertical padding of the metadata rows to 6px to restore the compact, cohesive grouping seen in the reference.

findings.issue: The orange active indicator line under the 'Run trace' tab is stretched wider than the text label, creating uneven horizontal spacing in the top navigation bar.
findings.fix: Align the active indicator line's width precisely to the 'Run trace' text label and maintain a consistent 16px gap between tabs.

findings.issue: Inconsistent inner padding around the action buttons (attachment, link, and send icons) inside the message input box, pushing the send button too close to the right edge.
findings.fix: Apply a uniform 12px inset padding to the input container to align all control icons cleanly with the text placeholder.

findings.issue: Icons in the Room Binder sidebar are colored in terracotta/orange, violating the 'neutral at rest' rule and diluting the singular agent focus accent.
findings.fix: Render all sidebar icons in neutral gray/white outlines to match the reference design.
